newsitem.title: USA: Campbell to reorganize intl businesses.
newsitem.headline: Campbell to reorganize intl businesses.

text.p: Campbell Soup Co said on Friday that it will reorganize its international businesses, sending senior managers overseas to head regional operations in Europe and Asia rather than having businesses in individual countries report to the U.S. headquarters.
The European operation, based in Brussels, is to be headed by F. Martin Thrasher, the company said in a news release.
The Asia operation will be run out of Hong Kong by Andrew Hughson.
Both executives will report to Dale Morrison, who was named Campbell's president and chief executive on June 30.
